name: Mutter Paneer
ingredients_raw: Water, Green Peas (26%), Paneer (Indian Cottage Cheese) (15%) (Milk), Onion, Cottonseed Oil, Tomato, Salt, Maize Starch, Cashews, Melon Seed Cane, Sugar, Garlic, Ginger and Spices (Coriander, Cumin, Chilli, Turmeric, Black Pepper, Cassia, Cardamom). Allergen Information: Contains Milk & Cashews. For allergen see ingredients in bold. May Contain Soy, Sesame, Mustard, Celery, Almonds, Pistachios, Coconut, Wheat, Gluten, Sulphites.
